subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Should maintainers accept source-level fixture proof for this classifier-only message-delivery fix, or require a live transport reproduction before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but it changes the branch that decides whether final assistant text is delivered or replaced by an incomplete-turn warning.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Proceed after normal gates using the PR's before/after terminal fixture and regression tests as sufficient proof for this helper-level fix.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a real configured channel run shows `update_plan` followed by a `stopReason=stop` final answer is delivered.

recommendation.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed after normal gates using the PR's before/after terminal fixture and regression tests as sufficient proof for this helper-level fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent terminal-classifier ownership makes this the best available proof-sufficiency routing candidate.
